## 4. 범용 아키텍처 가이드 (Reusable Blueprint)

### 4.1 의사결정 트리

```
사이트 「Instagram으로 계속하기」만 필요한가?
  ├─ YES → Facebook Login + UI 라벨 Instagram
  │         (Studio Canvas 패턴) ✅
  └─ NO, IG 미디어/인사이트도 필요?
        → Instagram Graph (Business/Creator) + Page 연동
           별도 제품·권한·토큰 설계 (본 가이드 범위 밖)
```

### 4.2 최소 구현 체크리스트

1. Meta 앱 + **Facebook Login** ON  
2. Redirect URI = Supabase callback  
3. Supabase Facebook Provider + Allow users without email  
4. UI 버튼 Instagram + `signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'facebook' })`  
5. `signInWithInstagram` alias  
6. **`custom:instagram` 만들지 않기**  
7. email scope는 Use case 승인 전 금지  
8. `/auth/callback` → bridge, www에서 시작

### 4.3 권장 소스 패턴

```ts
const TO_SUPABASE = {
  facebook: "facebook",
  instagram: "facebook", // unified Meta login
} as const;

export async function signInWithFacebook(next = "/app") {
  try {
    if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) throw new Error("Supabase not configured");
    saveNext(next);
    const supabase = createBrowserClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
      provider: "facebook",
      options: {
        redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`,
        // no scopes: "email" until Meta grants it
      },
    });
    if (error) {
      console.error("Meta/Facebook login error:", error.message);
      return { error };
    }
    return { data, error: null };
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    console.error("Meta/Facebook login error:", message);
    return { error: new Error(message) };
  }
}

export const signInWithInstagram = signInWithFacebook;
```

```tsx
// AuthModal
if (id === "facebook" || id === "instagram") {
  void handleMetaLogin(); // both call signInWithFacebook
}
```

### 4.4 Anti-patterns

| Anti-pattern | 결과 |
|--------------|------|
| Instagram Graph Business를 “로그인”으로 착각 | 불필요 권한·계정 유형 장벽 |
| `custom:instagram` 필수화 | Dashboard 누락 시 버튼만 실패 |
| Meta Redirect = 사이트 URL | token 교환 실패 |
| `scopes: "email"` 미승인 | Invalid Scopes |
| Auth.js `INSTAGRAM_*`만 설정 | 주 경로(Supabase)와 불일치 |
| IG in-app browser 무시 | PKCE/쿠키 간헐 실패 |
| 푸터 Instagram URL과 OAuth 혼동 | 잘못된 디버깅 |

### 4.5 검증 시나리오

- [ ] Instagram 버튼 → Meta 동의 → 앱 세션  
- [ ] Facebook 버튼과 **동일** Redirect/Provider 설정으로 성공  
- [ ] Supabase에 Instagram Custom provider **없음**  
- [ ] email 없는 계정 → synthetic email  
- [ ] www / 모바일  
- [ ] Instagram Graph 제품 없이도 로그인 가능  

---

## 5. 개발 일지 타임라인 (요약)

1. Auth.js Instagram env 폴백 골격  
2. UI에 Instagram 버튼 + 초기 `custom:instagram` 매핑 검토  
3. Facebook Login으로 **통일** (`instagram → facebook`, alias)  
4. email scope 제거 (`Invalid Scopes`) + synthetic email  
5. README/`.env.example`: Instagram UI = Facebook provider 명시  
6. Bridge 재시도·www PKCE  
7. **현재**: Instagram CTA는 Meta unified Facebook Login으로 안정 동작

## 7. FAQ

**Q. Instagram Graph API를 켜야 「Instagram으로 계속하기」가 되나요?**  
A. 아니요. Facebook Login + Supabase Facebook provider면 충분합니다.

**Q. 왜 동의 화면이 Facebook처럼 보이나요?**  
A. IdP가 Facebook Login이기 때문입니다. UI 브랜드만 Instagram입니다.

**Q. Instagram 비즈니스 계정이 필수인가요?**  
A. 이 로그인 경로에서는 아닙니다. Business/Creator+Page는 Graph 콘텐츠 API용입니다.

**Q. `INSTAGRAM_CLIENT_SECRET`을 Vercel에 넣어야 하나요?**  
A. 주 경로에서는 아니요. Supabase Facebook에 App Secret만 있으면 됩니다.

**Q. 가장 흔한 재발 원인 3가지?**  
A. (1) Instagram을 별도 Custom OAuth로 구성 (2) Redirect를 사이트에 등록 (3) 미승인 email/IG Graph scope를 로그인에 추가

# 마이크로소프트로 계속하기 (Microsoft Identity Platform / OIDC) 연동 완벽 가이드

> Studio Canvas AI (Next.js) — **「Microsoft로 계속하기」**  
> 기준 코드: `signInWithMicrosoft` (`custom:microsoft`), AuthModal, `/auth/callback` → `/auth/bridge`  
> 최종 정리일: 2026-08-08  
> 파일: `Integration_Log_v7.txt` (프로젝트 Root)

---

## 0. 한 줄 요약 (현재 아키텍처)

| 항목 | 실제 구현 |
|------|-----------|
| 프로토콜 | **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code** + **OpenID Connect** + **PKCE** |
| IdP | **Microsoft Entra ID** (Azure AD) — `login.microsoftonline.com` |
| 주 경로 | Supabase **Custom OAuth** — `provider: "custom:microsoft"` |
| 테넌트 | **`common`** (개인 MSA + 모든 조직 디렉터리) — 고정 tenant ID 금지 |
| 프론트 진입 | `AuthModal` → `signInWithMicrosoft()` |
| Azure Redirect URI | `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` |
| 앱 `redirectTo` | `${origin}/auth/callback?next=…` (`buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo`) |
| Scopes (앱) | `openid profile email offline_access` |
| Userinfo | `https://graph.microsoft.com/oidc/userinfo` (Dashboard; GoTrue 호출) |
| 대표 오류 | **AADSTS70016** (고정 테넌트 불일치) |
| 폴백 | Auth.js `MicrosoftEntraID` + `MICROSOFT_ISSUER=…/common/v2.0` |

앱은 Microsoft Graph REST(`User.Read`로 `/v1.0/me` 등)를 **직접 호출하지 않습니다.**  
프로필은 OIDC userinfo(및 id_token claims)를 **Supabase GoTrue**가 수집합니다.

---

## 1. 핵심 파일 구조 및 라우팅

### 1.1 프론트엔드 트리거 · 인증 요청 진입점

| 경로 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| `components/AuthModal.tsx` | Microsoft 버튼, `MicrosoftLogo`, `handleMicrosoftLogin` |
| `lib/supabase/oauth.ts` | **`signInWithMicrosoft`**, `TO_SUPABASE.microsoft = "custom:microsoft"`, provider 매핑 |
| `lib/supabase/client.ts` | 브라우저 Supabase 클라이언트 |
| `lib/i18n/locales/*` | `continueWithMicrosoft` |
| `components/CreditsProvider.tsx` | `"microsoft"` provider 타입 |

**버튼 → OAuth:**

```
handleMicrosoftLogin()
  setBusy(true)
  try
    next ← resolveAuthNext()
    signInWithMicrosoft(next)
      → saveAuthNextPath(next)
      → supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
           provider: "custom:microsoft",
           options: {
             redirectTo: buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo(next),
             scopes: "openid profile email offline_access",
           },
         })
    (성공) Microsoft로 이동 — busy 유지
  catch → console.error("예기치 못한 오류…") / "마이크로소프트 로그인 오류:"
```

### 1.2 콜백 · 토큰 · OIDC / Graph userinfo 라우트

| 경로 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| **Entra Redirect URI (Web)** | `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` |
| Supabase GoTrue | code → token (+ refresh via `offline_access`) → OIDC userinfo → `auth.users` |
| `middleware.ts` | Site `/` + `?code=` → `/auth/callback` (origin만으로 돌아올 때) |
| `app/auth/callback/route.ts` | PKCE `exchangeCodeForSession` → `/auth/bridge` |
| `lib/supabase/exchange.ts` | 세션 쿠키 |
| `app/auth/bridge/*` | Supabase 세션 → `/api/auth/supabase-bridge` |
| `app/api/auth/supabase-bridge/route.ts` | NextAuth JWT + 앱 유저 |
| `lib/auth.ts` | Auth.js `MicrosoftEntraID` 폴백 (`id: "microsoft"`, issuer `common`) |

**앱에 Microsoft token/userinfo 전용 API Route는 없습니다.**  
Authorize/Token/Issuer/JWKS/Userinfo URL은 **Supabase Dashboard Custom Provider**에만 존재합니다 (코드 하드코딩 없음).

### 1.3 Token Exchange / OIDC 로직 구조

```
[Browser]
  AuthModal → signInWithMicrosoft
       │  provider = custom:microsoft
       ▼
[Entra ID]  /common/oauth2/v2.0/authorize
            (client_id, redirect_uri=Supabase callback, scope, state, PKCE)
       │
       ▼
[Supabase]  /auth/v1/callback?code=…
       │  1) state / PKCE 검증
       │  2) POST …/common/oauth2/v2.0/token  (code → access_token, id_token, refresh_token)
       │  3) GET https://graph.microsoft.com/oidc/userinfo
       │       Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
       │  4) JWKS로 id_token 검증 (issuer = …/common/v2.0)
       │  5) auth.users upsert
       │  6) 앱 redirectTo 로 PKCE code
       ▼
[App]  /auth/callback?code=…&next=…
       │  exchangeSupabaseCode
       ▼
[App]  /auth/bridge → NextAuth session
```

**Scopes 해석**

| Scope | 역할 |
|-------|------|
| `openid` | OIDC id_token |
| `profile` | 이름 등 기본 프로필 |
| `email` | 이메일 claim |
| `offline_access` | refresh_token (GoTrue 세션 갱신에 유리) |

`User.Read`(Microsoft Graph 위임 권한)는 **별도 Graph REST**용입니다.  
현 로그인은 OIDC userinfo로 충분하며, 앱 코드에 `User.Read`를 넣지 않습니다. Dashboard/앱 등록에서 Graph 권한을 과도하게 요구하면 관리자 동의 장벽만 커질 수 있습니다.

### 1.4 엔드투엔드

```
User → Microsoft CTA
     → Entra (common) consent
     → Supabase token + oidc/userinfo
     → /auth/callback → /auth/bridge
     → /generate ± terms-consent
```

---

## 2. 트러블슈팅 및 에러 핸들링

### 2.1 Redirect URI 불일치

#### 증상
- `AADSTS50011` / redirect URI mismatch  
- 동의 후 잘못된 호스트

#### 올바른 삼각 관계

| 위치 | 값 |
|------|-----|
| **Entra** Web Redirect URI | `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` |
| **앱 `redirectTo`** | `https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/auth/callback?next=…` |
| **Supabase** Redirect URLs | `https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/**` |

#### 흔한 실수

| 잘못된 설정 | 결과 |
|-------------|------|
| Entra Redirect = 사이트 `/auth/callback` | GoTrue가 code를 못 받음 |
| 앱 `redirectTo` = 사이트의 `/auth/v1/callback` | 존재하지 않는 앱 경로 / 혼동 (README 경고) |
| Entra Redirect = Auth.js `/api/auth/callback/microsoft` | 주 경로(Supabase)와 단절 |

---

### 2.2 테넌트(Tenant) 유형 오류 — **AADSTS70016**

#### 증상
- `AADSTS70016`: 앱이 해당 디렉터리에 없음  
- 회사 계정은 되고 개인 Microsoft 계정은 실패(또는 그 반대)  
- 특정 조직만 로그인 가능

#### 원인
Supabase Custom Provider의 Authorization / Token / Issuer / JWKS에 **고정 디렉터리(tenant) GUID**를 넣음:

```text
https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-guid>/oauth2/v2.0/authorize  ← 문제
```

Entra 앱 등록의 “Supported account types”가 **단일 테넌트**인데 `common`으로 호출하거나, 그 반대 불일치.

#### 해결 (필수)

Dashboard 엔드포인트를 모두 **`common`** 으로 통일:

| Field | Value |
|--------|--------|
| Authorization | `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/authorize` |
| Token | `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token` |
| Issuer | `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/v2.0` |
| JWKS | `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/discovery/v2.0/keys` |

Entra 앱: **Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts**.

Auth.js 폴백: `MICROSOFT_ISSUER` 기본값 동일 `…/common/v2.0`.

코드 주석(`signInWithMicrosoft`)에 AADSTS70016 방지 가이드가 명시되어 있습니다.

---

### 2.3 Scopes / 권한 승인 누락

#### 증상
- consent 오류, email/profile 누락, admin consent 요구

#### 원인·대응

| 이슈 | 대응 |
|------|------|
| OIDC scope 누락 | 앱: `openid profile email offline_access` 유지 |
| `User.Read`를 로그인에 강제 | 불필요하면 제거; OIDC userinfo로 충분 |
| 조직에서 외부 앱 차단 | 테넌트 관리자 동의 또는 허용 목록 |
| email claim 없음 | Supabase “Allow users without an email” + 앱 프로필 폴백 |

Naver와 달리 Microsoft는 **`openid`를 포함**하는 것이 정상(OIDC)입니다.  
(`custom:naver`는 `openid` 넣으면 userinfo 스킵 — 혼동 주의, `Integration_Log_v3.txt`)

---

### 2.4 토큰 만료 · 세션 동기화

#### 증상
- Entra 동의 후 bridge 실패, `missing_code`, PKCE verifier 오류

#### 원인
- www ↔ apex  
- `redirectTo`를 origin만 쓰고 middleware 포워드에만 의존하다 code 유실 (현재 코드는 `/auth/callback?next=` 명시)  
- refresh 없이 장기 방치 후 API 401

#### 해결
- `buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo` 사용 (현 코드)  
- Redirect Allow List + www에서 시작  
- `offline_access`로 refresh_token 확보 (GoTrue)  
- Bridge retry + middleware code 포워드  
- 만료 시 재로그인 (앱이 Entra token을 직접 refresh하지 않음)

---

### 2.5 Custom provider id 오타

#### 증상
- Provider not enabled / unsupported provider

#### 해결
- Dashboard identifier: **`microsoft`**  
- 앱 호출: **`custom:microsoft`** (접두사 `custom:` 필수)  
- 과거 초안의 built-in `azure` 매핑은 **폐기** — 현재 `TO_SUPABASE.microsoft = "custom:microsoft"`

---

### 2.6 예외 처리 · 방어적 프로그래밍

| 계층 | 방어 |
|------|------|
| `signInWithMicrosoft` | try/catch, Supabase config 검사, `console.error("마이크로소프트 로그인 오류:")` / 예기치 못한 오류 로그 |
| `AuthModal.handleMicrosoftLogin` | UI 한국어 안내, busy 해제 |
| Provider 매핑 | `azure` / `custom:microsoft` / `microsoft` → 앱 `microsoft` |
| `/auth/callback` | oauth error / missing code / exchange catch |
| Bridge | session retry, timeout, failRedirect |
| `safeAuthNextPath` | open-redirect 방지 |
| Auth.js 폴백 | `common` issuer 기본값 |

---

## 3. Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Portal · 보안

### 3.1 앱 등록 체크리스트

**Entra ID → App registrations → (Studio Canvas AI)**

| Field | Value |
|--------|--------|
| Supported account types | **Any org directory + personal MSA** (`common`과 일치) |
| Redirect URI (Web) | `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` |
| Application (client) ID | → Supabase Custom provider Client ID |
| Client secret | → Supabase만 (브라우저·git 금지) |
| API permissions (최소) | OIDC용으로 Microsoft Graph `openid`/`profile`/`email` 수준; 과도한 `User.Read` 강제 지양 |

**Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Custom (`microsoft`)**

| Field | Value |
|--------|--------|
| Provider id (코드) | `custom:microsoft` |
| Type | OAuth2 / OIDC |
| Authorization / Token / Issuer / JWKS | 위 **common** URL 표 |
| Userinfo | `https://graph.microsoft.com/oidc/userinfo` |
| Scopes | `openid profile email offline_access` |
| Client ID / Secret | Entra와 동일 |

**URL Configuration:** Site URL + `https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/**`

### 3.2 환경 변수 표준

| 변수 | 위치 | 용도 |
|------|------|------|
| Client ID / Secret | **Supabase Custom `microsoft`** | **주 경로** |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `ANON_KEY` | 공개 | Auth 클라이언트 |
| `AUTH_SECRET` | 서버 | Bridge → NextAuth |
| `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` / `SECRET` | 서버 선택 | Auth.js 폴백 |
| `MICROSOFT_ISSUER` | 서버 선택 | 기본 `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/v2.0` |

Authorize/Token URL은 **앱 env에 두지 않음** — Dashboard만. Secret은 `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` 금지.

### 3.3 세션 생명주기 · 프로필 정규화

```
1. signInWithOAuth(custom:microsoft) + PKCE
2. Entra authorize (common) → code → Supabase
3. token (+ refresh) + id_token
4. GET graph.microsoft.com/oidc/userinfo
5. auth.users
6. App PKCE code → session cookies
7. Bridge → NextAuth JWT
8. extractSupabaseOAuthProfile
     provider = microsoft (from custom:microsoft / azure / microsoft)
     email / name / picture from user + metadata
     providerAccountId = Supabase user.id
9. findOrCreateOAuthUser / credits
```

| OIDC / Graph userinfo | 앱 |
|----------------------|-----|
| `sub` | identity 키 (metadata) |
| `email` | `email` |
| `name` / `preferred_username` | `name` |
| `picture` | `image` |
| Supabase UUID | 로컬 `providerAccountId` |

## 4. 범용 아키텍처 가이드 (Reusable Blueprint)

### 4.1 설계 원칙

1. Microsoft는 Supabase **Custom OAuth**로 붙인다 (`custom:<id>`)  
2. 다중 계정 지원 시 엔드포인트·앱 등록 모두 **`common`**  
3. Redirect는 **항상** `https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`  
4. 앱 `redirectTo`는 사이트 `/auth/callback` (IdP callback과 혼동 금지)  
5. 로그인 scope는 OIDC 최소 세트; Graph `User.Read`는 필요할 때만  
6. URL은 Dashboard에만 — 앱 코드에 tenant URL 하드코딩 지양

### 4.2 최소 구현 체크리스트

1. Entra 앱 등록 (multi-tenant + MSA)  
2. Redirect URI = Supabase callback  
3. Client secret 발급 → Supabase Custom `microsoft`  
4. common authorize/token/issuer/jwks + oidc userinfo  
5. Scopes: `openid profile email offline_access`  
6. `signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'custom:microsoft', … })`  
7. `/auth/callback` + bridge  
8. AADSTS70016 재현 테스트: 개인 계정 + 타 조직 계정

### 4.3 권장 소스 패턴

```ts
export async function signInWithMicrosoft(next = "/app") {
  try {
    if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) throw new Error("Supabase not configured");
    saveNext(next);
    const supabase = createBrowserClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
      provider: "custom:microsoft",
      options: {
        redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`,
        scopes: "openid profile email offline_access",
      },
    });
    if (error) {
      console.error("마이크로소프트 로그인 오류:", error.message);
      return { error };
    }
    return { data, error: null };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("예기치 못한 오류가 발생했습니다:", e);
    return { error: e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e)) };
  }
}
```

### 4.4 Anti-patterns

| Anti-pattern | 결과 |
|--------------|------|
| Token/Issuer에 tenant GUID 고정 | **AADSTS70016** |
| Entra를 single-tenant로 두고 common 호출 | 계정 유형 오류 |
| Redirect = 사이트 URL | code/token 주체 붕괴 |
| 앱 redirectTo = `/auth/v1/callback` on site | 잘못된 경로 |
| Naver처럼 `openid` 제거 | OIDC userinfo/id_token 깨짐 |
| `User.Read` 필수화(로그인만) | 불필요 admin consent |
| Secret 프론트 노출 | 보안 사고 |

### 4.5 Auth.js 폴백

```ts
MicrosoftEntraID({
  id: "microsoft",
  clientId: process.env.MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID,
  clientSecret: process.env.MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET,
  issuer:
    process.env.MICROSOFT_ISSUER ||
    "https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/v2.0",
})
```

주 경로는 Supabase Custom. Entra Redirect는 Supabase callback 유지.

### 4.6 검증 시나리오

- [ ] 개인 Microsoft 계정 로그인  
- [ ] 타 조직 직장/학교 계정 로그인 (AADSTS70016 없음)  
- [ ] Redirect mismatch 없음  
- [ ] bridge → 앱 세션 + 이메일/이름  
- [ ] www / localhost Redirect Allow List  
- [ ] Dashboard URL이 모두 `common`  

---

## 5. 개발 일지 타임라인 (요약)

1. Auth.js `MicrosoftEntraID` + `MICROSOFT_*` 폴백  
2. Supabase 연동 — 초기 `azure` 매핑 검토 후 **`custom:microsoft`로 확정**  
3. **AADSTS70016** — 고정 tenant → 전 엔드포인트 `common` + Entra multi-account  
4. Redirect/redirectTo 혼동 문서화 (사이트 `/auth/v1/callback` 금지)  
5. scopes `openid profile email offline_access`, userinfo = Graph OIDC  
6. `buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo`로 앱 콜백 명시  
7. **현재**: Microsoft Custom OIDC 로그인 안정

---

## 6. 빠른 레퍼런스

```text
UI                : AuthModal → handleMicrosoftLogin
OAuth             : signInWithMicrosoft → custom:microsoft
Authorize         : https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/authorize
Token             : https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token
Issuer / JWKS     : …/common/v2.0  &  …/common/discovery/v2.0/keys
Userinfo          : https://graph.microsoft.com/oidc/userinfo
Scopes            : openid profile email offline_access
Entra Redirect    : https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback
App redirectTo    : /auth/callback?next=…
Critical error    : AADSTS70016 → use common, not fixed tenant
Secrets           : Supabase Custom provider (primary)
Auth.js fallback  : MICROSOFT_CLIENT_* + MICROSOFT_ISSUER=common
```

---

## 7. FAQ

**Q. built-in `azure` provider를 쓰나요?**  
A. 아니요. 코드는 **`custom:microsoft`** 입니다.

**Q. `User.Read`가 꼭 필요한가요?**  
A. 이 앱 로그인만으로는 아닙니다. OIDC userinfo로 프로필을 받습니다.

**Q. 왜 Naver는 openid를 빼는데 Microsoft는 넣나요?**  
A. Naver는 nested userinfo 프록시 강제용 예외. Microsoft는 표준 OIDC라 `openid`가 맞습니다.

**Q. 가장 흔한 재발 원인 3가지?**  
A. (1) 고정 tenant → AADSTS70016 (2) Redirect를 사이트에 등록 (3) 앱 redirectTo를 Supabase callback 경로와 혼동

# 카카오로 계속하기 (Kakao OAuth 2.0 / REST API Key & BaaS Integration) 연동 완벽 가이드

> Studio Canvas AI (Next.js) — **「카카오로 계속하기」**  
> 기준 코드: `signInWithKakao` (`provider: "kakao"`), AuthModal, `/auth/callback` → `/auth/bridge`  
> 최종 정리일: 2026-08-08  
> 파일: `Integration_Log_v8.txt` (프로젝트 Root)

---

## 0. 한 줄 요약 (현재 아키텍처)

| 항목 | 실제 구현 |
|------|-----------|
| 프로토콜 | **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code** + **PKCE** |
| IdP | **Kakao Developers** (카카오 로그인) — `kauth.kakao.com` / `kapi.kakao.com` |
| 주 경로 | Supabase **built-in Kakao** — `provider: "kakao"` (**`custom:kakao` 사용 금지**) |
| 프론트 진입 | `AuthModal` → `handleKakaoLogin` → `signInWithKakao()` |
| Kakao Redirect URI | `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` |
| 앱 `redirectTo` | `${origin}/auth/callback?next=…` (`buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo`) — 기본 `next=/` |
| Scopes (앱) | `queryParams.scope = "profile_nickname,profile_image"` (**`account_email` 미요청**) |
| 이메일 정책 | Supabase **Allow users without an email** + 합성 `{kakaoId}@users.kakao.id` |
| 대표 오류 | **KOE006** (redirect_uri 불일치) · **KOE205** (`account_email` 동의 항목) |
| Canonical project | `oorujqbivznftsyqilyj` — 테스트 ref `ysdccsfpxduqcqxgwuy` **폐기** |
| 폴백 | Auth.js `Kakao` (`KAKAO_CLIENT_ID` / `SECRET`) — Supabase 미구성 시에만 |

앱은 Kakao REST(`kapi.kakao.com/v2/user/me`)를 **로그인 주경로에서 직접 호출하지 않습니다.**  
토큰 교환·유저 수집은 **Supabase GoTrue**가 담당합니다.  
(선택) `kakao-userinfo` Edge Function / `/api/auth/kakao/userinfo`는 실험용으로만 존재합니다.

**카카오 로그인(OAuth)** 과 **카카오톡 공유(JS SDK)** 는 별개입니다.  
공유는 `lib/kakaoShare.ts`의 JavaScript 키를 쓰며, 로그인 REST API Key와 혼동하지 마세요.

---

## 1. 핵심 파일 구조 및 라우팅 (Components & API Routes)

### 1.1 프론트엔드 트리거 · 인증 요청 진입점

| 경로 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| `components/AuthModal.tsx` | 카카오 버튼, `handleKakaoLogin`, `formatOAuthError` 표시 |
| `lib/supabase/oauth.ts` | **`signInWithKakao`**, `TO_SUPABASE.kakao = "kakao"`, `extractSupabaseOAuthProfile` |
| `lib/supabase/client.ts` | 브라우저 Supabase 클라이언트 (`createBrowserClient` + PKCE) |
| `lib/supabase/config.ts` | `CANONICAL_SUPABASE_*`, retired ref 차단, env 검증 |
| `lib/supabase/authStorage.ts` | 타 프로젝트 `sb-*-auth-*` 쿠키/스토리지 퍼지 |
| `lib/supabase/oauthErrors.ts` | KOE205 / redirect_uri / email 메시지 정규화 |
| `lib/i18n/locales/*` | `continueWithKakao` 등 카피 |
| `components/CreditsProvider.tsx` | `"kakao"` provider 타입 · `authError` 모달 재표시 |

**버튼 → OAuth:**

```
handleKakaoLogin()
  setBusy(true)
  try
    next ← resolveAuthNext()          // 기본 "/", 요금제면 "/pricing"
    signInWithKakao(next)
      → isSupabaseConfigured() 검사
      → saveAuthNextPath(next)
      → ensureSupabaseAuthStorageReady()   // retired/test PKCE 잔여 제거
      → supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
           provider: "kakao",
           options: {
             redirectTo: buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo(next),
             queryParams: { scope: "profile_nickname,profile_image" },
           },
         })
    (성공) 브라우저가 카카오 동의 화면으로 이동 — busy 유지
  catch / oauthError → formatOAuthError → setError / setBusy(false)
```

### 1.2 BaaS 게이트웨이 · 콜백 · 세션 초기화

| 경로 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| **Kakao Redirect URI** | `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` |
| Supabase GoTrue | Kakao authorize → code → token → (가능하면) user/me → `auth.users` |
| `middleware.ts` | Site `/` + `?code=` → `/auth/callback` (origin만으로 돌아올 때) |
| `app/auth/callback/route.ts` | PKCE `exchangeSupabaseCode` → `/auth/bridge?next=…` |
| `lib/supabase/exchange.ts` | 세션 쿠키 기록 |
| `app/auth/bridge/page.tsx` | 클라이언트 브릿지 셸 + 타임아웃 탈출 |
| `app/auth/bridge/BridgeClient.tsx` | `getSession` → `POST /api/auth/supabase-bridge` |
| `app/api/auth/supabase-bridge/route.ts` | NextAuth JWT 발급 + 앱 유저 upsert |
| `lib/termsConsent.ts` | 미동의 시 `/terms-consent?next=/` (기본 next는 홈) |
| `app/terms-consent/*` | 약관 게이트 |
| `lib/auth.ts` | Auth.js `Kakao` 폴백 (`id: "kakao"`) |

**선택(비주경로) 헬퍼:**

| 경로 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| `app/api/auth/kakao/userinfo/route.ts` | Kakao nested → flat claims 프록시 (실험) |
| `supabase/functions/kakao-userinfo/index.ts` | Edge Function 동일 목적 |
| `lib/supabase/kakao-userinfo.ts` | 클라이언트/서버 헬퍼 |

**앱에 Kakao token 전용 로그인 API Route는 없습니다.**  
REST API Key / Client Secret은 **Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → Providers → Kakao**에만 둡니다.

### 1.3 End-to-end 시퀀스

```
[Browser] AuthModal "카카오로 계속하기"
    │
    ▼
signInWithOAuth({ provider: "kakao", redirectTo: https://www…/auth/callback?next=/ })
    │
    ▼
[Kakao] kauth…/oauth/authorize
    · client_id = Supabase에 등록된 REST API Key
    · redirect_uri = https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback   ← KOE006의 핵심
    · scope = profile_nickname,profile_image                                    ← KOE205 회피
    │
    ▼
[Supabase GoTrue] /auth/v1/callback
    · code ↔ Kakao token
    · (email 없으면) Allow users without an email 로 통과
    · 사이트 redirectTo 로 복귀: /auth/callback?code=…&next=/
    │
    ▼
[Next.js] app/auth/callback/route.ts
    · exchangeSupabaseCode (PKCE cookies)
    · redirect → /auth/bridge?next=/
    │
    ▼
[BridgeClient]
    · supabase.auth.getSession()
    · POST /api/auth/supabase-bridge { accessToken }
    · extractSupabaseOAuthProfile → 합성 email / nickname / image
    · needsTermsConsent ? /terms-consent?next=/ : location.replace("/")
    │
    ▼
[App] NextAuth JWT + 로컬 유저 행 · 홈 랜딩 `/`
```

### 1.4 로그인 성공 후 기본 도착지

2026-08-08 기준: 소셜 로그인 성공 후 **기본 `next`는 `/`(메인 랜딩)** 입니다.  
`/generate`는 더 이상 기본값이 아닙니다.  
의도적 deep-link(`saveAuthNextPath`, 요금제 `/pricing` 등)만 예외입니다.

관련 기본값 위치:

- `lib/supabase/oauth.ts` — `buildAuthCallbackRedirectTo`, `signInWithKakao(nextPath = "/")`
- `app/auth/callback/route.ts` — `safeNextPath` fallback `"/"`
- `app/auth/bridge/BridgeClient.tsx` — `readNextPath` fallback `"/"`
- `lib/termsConsent.ts` — `DEFAULT_AFTER_CONSENT = "/"`
- `components/AuthModal.tsx` — `peekAuthNextPath("/")` / `consumeAuthNextPath("/")`

## 2. 트러블슈팅 및 에러 핸들링 (Troubleshooting & Edge Cases)

### 2.1 KOE006 — Redirect URI 불일치 (치명적)

**증상**

- 카카오 로그인 화면에서 `KOE006` / “등록되지 않은 redirect_uri” / 앱 관리자 설정 오류
- 브라우저 Network의 authorize URL `redirect_uri`가 예상과 다름

**근본 원인 (Studio Canvas에서 실제로 겪은 것)**

1. **Kakao가 보는 `redirect_uri`는 앱 `redirectTo`가 아니다.**  
   GoTrue가 항상 `https://<NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL의 project-ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` 을 Kakao에 넘긴다.
2. Vercel Production의 `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `ANON_KEY`가 **비어 있거나 예시·오타·다른 프로젝트**였음.
3. **프로젝트 2개 혼선**
   - 본체(정식): `oorujqbivznftsyqilyj` (모든 소셜 + 데이터)
   - 테스트(폐기): `ysdccsfpxduqcqxgwuy` (DNS NXDOMAIN / 잘못된 콜백)
4. Kakao Developers에 **Default 앱 REST Key**와 **Studio Canvas용 앱**이 섞여,  
   Supabase에 넣은 Key와 Redirect URI를 등록한 앱이 **서로 다른 앱**이었을 가능성.

**해결 체크리스트**

| # | 확인 |
|---|------|
| 1 | Vercel Production: `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co` |
| 2 | 동일 프로젝트의 Publishable/Anon Key |
| 3 | `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` 변경 후 **반드시** `vercel --prod` 재배포 |
| 4 | Kakao Developers → **그 REST Key가 속한 앱** → Redirect URI에  
   `https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` **정확히 1줄** |
| 5 | 사이트 origin(`https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/**`)은 **Supabase Auth Redirect URLs**에 등록 (Kakao 콘솔이 아님) |
| 6 | 로컬 `.env.local`도 동일 canonical ref (로컬만 틀려도 KOE006 재현) |

**코드 방어**

- `lib/supabase/config.ts` — `RETIRED_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REFS`에 `ysdccsfpxduqcqxgwuy` → URL 정규화 단계에서 **거부**
- `getSupabaseConfigError()` — retired URL이면 canonical 안내 메시지
- `authStorage.ensureSupabaseAuthStorageReady()` — `sb-ysdccsf…-*` 쿠키/키 퍼지
- OAuth 직전(Kakao/Google 등) 동일 퍼지 호출

**진단 한 줄**

> Kakao 콘솔 Redirect URI ≡ GoTrue가 보내는 URI ≡ `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`의 project-ref.  
> 셋 중 하나라도 어긋나면 KOE006.

### 2.2 KOE205 / “Error getting user email from external provider”

**증상**

- KOE205: 동의 항목 `account_email` 미설정 / 개인 앱에서 이메일 스코프 불가
- Supabase: `Error getting user email from external provider`

**근본 원인**

- 개인(비비즈) 카카오 앱은 **`account_email` 동의 항목을 쓸 수 없는 경우**가 많음
- GoTrue 기본 동작은 email claim을 기대 → 없으면 실패

**해결 (현재 프로덕션 패턴)**

1. **앱 코드** — `account_email`을 요청하지 않음:

```ts
queryParams: { scope: "profile_nickname,profile_image" }
```

2. **Supabase Dashboard → Providers → Kakao**  
   - **Allow users without an email** = ON

3. **앱 브릿지** — `extractSupabaseOAuthProfile`:  
   - Kakao `id` / `sub` → `kakaoSub`  
   - email 없으면 `{kakaoSub}@users.kakao.id` (또는 `{supabaseUserId}@users.kakao.id`)

4. **UI** — `formatOAuthError`가 KOE205를 한국어 안내로 변환

**비즈 전환 시 (선택)**

- Kakao에서 `account_email` 활성화 후 scope에 추가 가능  
- 그래도 “이메일 없는 카카오 계정”이 있으므로 Allow users without an email은 유지 권장

### 2.3 Vercel env · 테스트 프로젝트 잔여물로 인한 라우팅 붕괴

**증상**

- 프로덕션 JS에 엉뚱한 ref가 박히거나, 로그인 직후 DNS/콜백 실패
- 예전 프로젝트 쿠키가 PKCE를 오염

**차단 레이어**

| 레이어 | 구현 |
|--------|------|
| Env 문서 | `.env.example`, `supabase/README.md` — canonical URL/키 명시, retired 경고 |
| Runtime URL | `normalizeSupabaseUrl` — retired ref → `undefined` |
| Storage | `purgeStaleSupabaseAuthStorage` — foreign + retired `sb-*` 제거 |
| Client init | `createSupabaseBrowserClient`가 항상 storage ready 호출 |
| Link CLI | `supabase/config.toml` → `project_id = "oorujqbivznftsyqilyj"` |

**운영 규칙**

- 소셜·DB·Edge Function은 **한 프로젝트(`oorujqb…`)만** 사용
- Preview/Production 모두 동일 URL 권장 (키가 Preview에서 테스트 ref로 바뀌면 KOE006 재발)
- 비밀키(Client Secret, service_role)는 Vercel에만 — 레포/문서에 실값 금지

### 2.4 기타 Edge Cases

| 현상 | 원인 | 대응 |
|------|------|------|
| PKCE / code verifier | www ↔ apex / localhost 혼용 | 시작·종료 동일 origin; Redirect URLs에 각 origin/** |
| `custom:kakao` 실패 | Custom provider 미구성 | **built-in `kakao`만** 사용 |
| 로그인 후 /generate | 구버전 기본 next | 현재 기본 `/` (재배포 확인) |
| 약관 페이지 먼저 | `needsTermsConsent` | 정상 — 동의 후 `next=/` |
| Auth.js 폴백과 이중 등록 | `KAKAO_CLIENT_*` + Supabase 동시 | 주경로는 Supabase; Auth.js는 폴백 |

---

## 3. 카카오 개발자 콘솔 연동 규격 및 보안

### 3.1 Kakao Developers 필수 설정

| 항목 | 값 / 규칙 |
|------|-----------|
| 플랫폼 | Web — 사이트 도메인 `https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com` 등 |
| 카카오 로그인 | **활성화** |
| Redirect URI | **`https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`만** (사이트 `/auth/callback` 아님) |
| 동의 항목 | `닉네임`, `프로필 사진` (필수에 가깝게) · `계정 이메일`은 가능 시만 |
| REST API Key | → Supabase Kakao **Client ID** |
| Client Secret | 코드 활성화 ON → Supabase Kakao **Client Secret** |

**중요:** Redirect URI에 `https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/auth/callback` 을 넣어도  
Kakao authorize의 `redirect_uri`는 Supabase 호스트이므로 **KOE006이 해결되지 않습니다.**

### 3.2 환경 변수 관리 표준

**앱(Vercel / `.env.local`) — 공개 가능 쪽**

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://oorujqbivznftsyqilyj.supabase.co
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<publishable or legacy anon JWT>
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com
AUTH_SECRET=<NextAuth secret>
AUTH_URL / NEXTAUTH_URL=<SITE_URL과 동일>
```

**Supabase Dashboard only (앱 env에 넣지 않음)**

```
Kakao Client ID     = Kakao REST API Key
Kakao Client Secret = Kakao Client Secret
```

**Auth.js 폴백(선택)**

```
KAKAO_CLIENT_ID=
KAKAO_CLIENT_SECRET=
```

**공유 SDK와 분리**

- `NEXT_PUBLIC_KAKAO_JS_KEY` / `lib/kakaoShare.ts` — **톡 공유용 JS 키**
- 로그인 REST Key와 **절대 혼용하지 말 것**
- 레거시 차단 키 규칙은 `lib/kakaoShare.ts` 주석 참고

### 3.3 식별자 · 프로필 정규화 · 세션 생명주기

**정규화 (`extractSupabaseOAuthProfile`)**

| 필드 | 소스 우선순위 |
|------|----------------|
| `provider` | `app_metadata.provider` / identity → `"kakao"` |
| `providerAccountId` | **항상** Supabase `user.id` (UUID) — 로컬 유저 키 |
| `kakaoSub` | `sub` / `provider_id` / `id` / `kakao_account.id` |
| `email` | 실이메일 → 없으면 `{kakaoSub}@users.kakao.id` |
| `name` | `nickname` / `properties.nickname` / `kakao_account.profile.nickname` |
| `image` | `profile_image` / thumbnail / `profile_image_url` |

**세션 생명주기**

1. Supabase Auth 세션 (PKCE cookies, `sb-<ref>-auth-token`)
2. Bridge가 access token으로 **NextAuth JWT** 발급 (앱 세션)
3. JWT `maxAge` ≈ 30일 (`lib/auth.ts`)
4. 약관 미동의 → `/terms-consent` 게이트 (middleware / bridge)
5. 로그아웃: Supabase signOut + NextAuth signOut + 관련 쿠키 정리 (`/api/auth/logout` 등)
6. 프로젝트 전환 시: `ensureSupabaseAuthStorageReady`가 이전 ref 키 제거

---

## 4. 범용 아키텍처 가이드 (Reusable Blueprint)

다른 Next.js + Supabase 프로젝트에 카카오 로그인을 이식할 때의 **표준 패턴**입니다.

### 4.1 결정 트리

```
Q1. Supabase built-in Kakao를 쓸 수 있는가?
  YES → provider: "kakao"  (권장, Studio Canvas 채택)
  NO  → Custom OAuth + userinfo flatten 프록시 (실험 경로만)

Q2. 카카오 앱이 개인(비비즈)인가?
  YES → scope에서 account_email 제외 + Allow users without an email + 합성 email
  NO  → email 동의 가능해도 Allow users without an email 유지 권장

Q3. Redirect URI를 어디에 등록하는가?
  Kakao Developers → https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback
  Supabase Redirect URLs → https://your-site.com/**  (앱 redirectTo)
```

### 4.2 최소 구현 체크리스트 (복붙용)

1. Supabase 프로젝트 1개 확정 → URL/Anon Key를 `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`에 고정  
2. Kakao 앱 1개 확정 → REST Key + Secret을 Supabase Kakao Provider에만 저장  
3. Kakao Redirect URI = `https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`  
4. 프론트:

```ts
await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
  provider: "kakao",
  options: {
    redirectTo: `${origin}/auth/callback?next=/`,
    queryParams: { scope: "profile_nickname,profile_image" },
  },
});
```

5. `/auth/callback`에서 PKCE code exchange → 앱 세션 브릿지  
6. 프로필 정규화에서 email 없을 때 `{id}@users.kakao.id`  
7. retired/test project ref 하드코딩 금지 + env 검증으로 차단  
8. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` 변경 시 반드시 프로덕션 재배포

### 4.3 절대 하지 말 것

| 금지 | 이유 |
|------|------|
| Kakao Redirect에 사이트 `/auth/callback`만 등록 | KOE006 — GoTrue는 Supabase 호스트를 보냄 |
| `custom:kakao`와 built-in `kakao` 혼용 | provider id / userinfo 불일치 |
| Vercel에 빈/예시 `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | 잘못된 redirect_uri 또는 설정 실패 |
| 테스트·본체 프로젝트 키 교차 | 콜백·유저 DB·세션 완전 붕괴 |
| REST Key를 클라이언트에 노출하며 직접 token 교환 | Secret 유출 · 아키텍처 이탈 |
| 로그인 Key와 JS 공유 Key 혼동 | 서로 다른 카카오 제품 |

### 4.4 파일 템플릿 맵 (이 레포 기준)

```
components/AuthModal.tsx          # UI 트리거
lib/supabase/oauth.ts             # signInWithKakao + profile normalize
lib/supabase/config.ts            # canonical URL / retired refs
lib/supabase/authStorage.ts       # PKCE/project purge
lib/supabase/client.ts            # browser client
lib/supabase/oauthErrors.ts       # KOE* UX
app/auth/callback/route.ts        # code → bridge
app/auth/bridge/BridgeClient.tsx  # session → NextAuth
app/api/auth/supabase-bridge/     # app session mint
lib/termsConsent.ts               # post-login gate + next=/
```

### 4.5 검증 시나리오

1. 시크릿 창에서 「카카오로 계속하기」  
2. authorize URL의 `redirect_uri`가 canonical Supabase callback인지 확인  
3. 동의(닉네임/프로필만) 후 `/auth/callback` → `/auth/bridge` → `/` (또는 terms)  
4. Network/Application에서 `sb-oorujqb…-auth-token`만 존재, retired ref 키 없음  
5. 이메일 없는 계정으로도 bridge `ok: true`  
6. KOE006 재현 테스트: 잘못된 URL을 Kakao에만 넣고 → 실패하는지로 역검증

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useI18n } from "@/components/I18nProvider";
import type { SupportTicket } from "@/lib/supportTickets";
import type { AuthProviderId, PlanId } from "@/lib/db/types";

type AdminUserRow = {
  id: string;
  email: string | null;
  name: string | null;
  provider: AuthProviderId;
  planId: PlanId;
  credits: number;
  createdAt: number;
};

function formatSignedUp(ts: number, locale: string) {
  try {
    return new Date(ts).toLocaleString(locale === "kr" ? "ko-KR" : "en-US", {
      year: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    });
  } catch {
    return new Date(ts).toISOString();
  }
}

export default function AdminPageClient() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicket[]>([]);
  const [ticketsLoading, setTicketsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [ticketsError, setTicketsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<AdminUserRow[]>([]);
  const [usersLoading, setUsersLoading] = useState(true);
  const [usersError, setUsersError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadTickets = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/tickets", {
        cache: "no-store",
        credentials: "same-origin",
      });
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok?: boolean;
        tickets?: SupportTicket[];
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok || !Array.isArray(data.tickets)) {
        throw new Error(data.error || "tickets_failed");
      }
      setTickets(data.tickets);
      setTicketsError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setTicketsError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "tickets_failed");
    } finally {
      setTicketsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const patchTicket = useCallback(
    async (
      id: string,
      patch: Partial<Pick<SupportTicket, "status" | "adminNote">>
    ) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/tickets", {
        method: "PATCH",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id, ...patch }),
      });
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok?: boolean;
        ticket?: SupportTicket;
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok || !data.ticket) {
        throw new Error(data.error || "update_failed");
      }
      setTickets((prev) => prev.map((t) => (t.id === id ? data.ticket! : t)));
    },
    []
  );

  const loadUsers = useCallback(async () => {
    setUsersLoading(true);
    setUsersError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok?: boolean;
        users?: AdminUserRow[];
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok || !Array.isArray(data.users)) {
        throw new Error(data.error || t.admin.membersError);
      }
      setUsers(data.users);
    } catch (err) {
      setUsers([]);
      setUsersError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : t.admin.membersError);
    } finally {
      setUsersLoading(false);
    }
  }, [t.admin.membersError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadTickets();
    const id = setInterval(() => void loadTickets(), 4000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [loadTickets]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadUsers();
  }, [loadUsers]);

  return (
    <section className="section-padding mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-12 pt-28">
      <header>
        <h1 className="font-display mb-2 text-3xl font-bold">{t.admin.title}</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-white/50">{t.admin.subtitle}</p>
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-white/40">
          <Link href="/admin/promotions" className="underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-white/70">
            Promotions
          </Link>
        </p>
      </header>

      <div>
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">{t.admin.membersTitle}</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-white/50">{t.admin.membersSubtitle}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void loadUsers()}
              className="rounded-lg border border-white/15 bg-white/5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white/70 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
            >
              Refresh
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                void (async () => {
                  await fetch("/api/admin/logout", {
                    method: "POST",
                    credentials: "same-origin",
                  });
                  window.location.href = "/admin";
                })();
              }}
              className="rounded-lg border border-white/15 bg-white/5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white/70 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
            >
              Log out
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p className="mb-4 text-sm font-medium text-glow-emerald">
          {t.admin.membersTotal.replace("{count}", String(users.length))}
        </p>

        {usersLoading ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-white/40">{t.admin.membersLoading}</p>
        ) : usersError ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-red-300">{usersError}</p>
        ) : users.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-white/40">{t.admin.membersEmpty}</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="glass-card overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full text-left text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-white/10 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-white/45">
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{t.admin.colEmail}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{t.admin.colName}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{t.admin.colProvider}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{t.admin.colPlan}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{t.admin.colCredits}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{t.admin.colSignedUp}</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {users.map((user) => (
                  <tr
                    key={user.id}
                    className="border-b border-white/5 text-white/80 last:border-0"
                  >
                    <td className="max-w-[220px] truncate px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-white/90">
                      {user.email || "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">{user.name || "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 capitalize">{user.provider}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 capitalize">{user.planId}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 tabular-nums">{user.credits}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-xs text-white/55">
                      {formatSignedUp(user.createdAt, locale)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">{t.admin.ticketsTitle}</h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void loadTickets()}
            className="rounded-lg border border-white/15 bg-white/5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white/70 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
          >
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>
        {ticketsLoading && tickets.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-white/40">Loading…</p>
        ) : ticketsError && tickets.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-red-300">{ticketsError}</p>
        ) : tickets.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-white/40">{t.admin.empty}</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {tickets.map((ticket) => (
              <article key={ticket.id} className="glass-card space-y-3 p-4 sm:p-5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{ticket.subject}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-white/40">
                      {ticket.email} · #{ticket.id}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <select
                    value={ticket.status}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      void patchTicket(ticket.id, {
                        status: e.target.value as SupportTicket["status"],
                      }).catch((err) => {
                        setTicketsError(
                          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "update_failed"
                        );
                      });
                    }}
                    className="rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                  >
                    <option value="open">open</option>
                    <option value="in_progress">in_progress</option>
                    <option value="resolved">resolved</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-white/70">{ticket.body}</p>
                <label className="block text-xs text-white/40">{t.admin.note}</label>
                <textarea
                  defaultValue={ticket.adminNote ?? ""}
                  rows={2}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none"
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    void patchTicket(ticket.id, { adminNote: e.target.value }).catch(
                      (err) => {
                        setTicketsError(
                          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "update_failed"
                        );
                      }
                    );
                  }}
                />
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE PATH: app/admin/layout.tsx

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { getAdminSession } from "@/lib/adminAuth";
import AdminLoginForm from "@/components/AdminLoginForm";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Gate all /admin routes behind the dedicated admin cookie session.
 * Shows AdminLoginForm instead of 404 when unauthenticated.
 */
export default async function AdminLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session) {
    return <AdminLoginForm />;
  }
  return children;
}

        <h1 className="font-display mt-2 text-3xl font-bold">프로모션 코드 관리</h1>
        <p className="mb-8 mt-2 text-sm text-white/50">
          선불 잔액형 코드를 일괄 발급하고 잔액 및 사용 이력을 확인합니다.
        </p>
        <PromotionAdminDashboard />
      </section>
      <Footer />
    </main>
  );

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { getToken } from "next-auth/jwt";
import { auth, listSocialProviders, authConfigured } from "@/lib/auth";
import { isSupabaseConfigured, getSupabaseConfigError } from "@/lib/supabase/config";
import { findOrCreateOAuthUser, getUserById, ensureUserRecord, reconcileUserWithWalletCookie } from "@/lib/db/credits";
import type { AuthProviderId } from "@/lib/db/types";
import { FREE_CREDITS } from "@/lib/data";
import { getPaymentProvider } from "@/lib/payments";
import { getPortoneStoreId } from "@/lib/payments/portone";
import { resolveInferenceProvider } from "@/lib/ai/inference";
import { getBusinessInfo, isBusinessInfoComplete } from "@/lib/business";
import { normalizeSubscriptionLifecycle } from "@/lib/subscriptionState";
import {
  authSessionCookieName,
  useSecureAuthCookies,
} from "@/lib/authCookies";
import { requireAuthSecret } from "@/lib/authSecret";
import { hasUnlimitedCredits, isUnlimitedAccountEmail } from "@/lib/unlimitedAccount";
import { isAdminEmail } from "@/lib/adminAuth";
import { readWalletCookie } from "@/lib/walletCookie";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

/** Current account snapshot for client CreditsProvider sync. */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await auth();
  let userId = (session?.user as { id?: string } | undefined)?.id;
  let user = userId ? await getUserById(userId) : null;
  if (user) {
    user = await reconcileUserWithWalletCookie(user);
  }

  // Vercel memory DB can be empty after a cold start even with a valid JWT.
  // Rehydrate the local user from JWT claims when possible.
  if (!user) {
    try {
      const secret = requireAuthSecret();
      const token = await getToken({
        req: request,
        secret,
        secureCookie: useSecureAuthCookies(),
        cookieName: authSessionCookieName(),
      });

      if (token?.termsAgreed === false) {
        // Provisional pre-consent session — not a registered app member yet.
        return NextResponse.json({
          authenticated: false,
          pendingTermsConsent: true,
          user: null,
          providers: listSocialProviders(),
          supabaseConfigured: isSupabaseConfigured(),
          supabaseConfigError: getSupabaseConfigError(),
          authConfigured: authConfigured(),
          paymentProvider: getPaymentProvider(),
          aiProvider: resolveInferenceProvider(),
          business: getBusinessInfo(),
          businessComplete: isBusinessInfoComplete(),
          tossClientKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TOSS_CLIENT_KEY || null,
          portoneStoreId: getPortoneStoreId(),
          stripePublishableKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || null,
        });
      }

      const provider = token?.authProvider as AuthProviderId | undefined;
      const providerAccountId =
        typeof token?.providerAccountId === "string"
          ? token.providerAccountId
          : typeof token?.supabaseUserId === "string"
            ? token.supabaseUserId
            : null;

      const provisionalId = String(
        userId || token?.uid || ""
      );
      const wallet = await readWalletCookie(provisionalId || null);
      const jwtCredits =
        typeof token?.credits === "number" ? token.credits : null;
      const creditsHint = wallet?.credits ?? jwtCredits ?? null;

      if (provider && providerAccountId && token) {
        const created = await findOrCreateOAuthUser({
          provider,
          providerAccountId,
          email: typeof token.email === "string" ? token.email : null,
          name: typeof token.name === "string" ? token.name : null,
          image: typeof token.picture === "string" ? token.picture : null,
          creditsHint,
        });
        user = created.user;
        userId = user.id;
      } else if (token?.uid || session?.user) {
        // Session exists — auto-provision wallet so generate/credits stay in sync.
        const id = String(token?.uid || userId || "");
        if (id) {
          user = await ensureUserRecord({
            userId: id,
            email:
              session?.user?.email ??
              (typeof token?.email === "string" ? token.email : null),
            name:
              session?.user?.name ??
              (typeof token?.name === "string" ? token.name : null),
            image:
              session?.user?.image ??
              (typeof token?.picture === "string" ? token.picture : null),
            provider,
            providerAccountId,
            credits: creditsHint ?? FREE_CREDITS,
          });
          userId = user.id;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      /* fall through with whatever we have */
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    authenticated: Boolean(user),
    user: user
      ? {
          id: user.id,
          email: user.email,
          name: user.name,
          image: user.image,
          credits: user.credits,
          maxCredits: user.maxCredits,
          unlimitedCredits: hasUnlimitedCredits(user.email),
          isAdmin: Boolean(
            user.email &&
              (isAdminEmail(user.email) || isUnlimitedAccountEmail(user.email))
          ),
          planId: user.planId,
          billingInterval: user.billingInterval ?? null,
          currentPeriodStart: user.currentPeriodStart ?? null,
          currentPeriodEnd: user.currentPeriodEnd ?? null,
          subscriptionLifecycle: normalizeSubscriptionLifecycle(user),
          cancelAtPeriodEnd: user.cancelAtPeriodEnd ?? false,
          defaultPaymentMethodLabel: user.defaultPaymentMethodLabel ?? null,
          stripeCustomerId: user.stripeCustomerId ?? null,
          provider: user.provider,
        }
      : null,
    providers: listSocialProviders(),
    supabaseConfigured: isSupabaseConfigured(),
    supabaseConfigError: getSupabaseConfigError(),
    authConfigured: authConfigured(),
    paymentProvider: getPaymentProvider(),
    aiProvider: resolveInferenceProvider(),
    business: getBusinessInfo(),
    businessComplete: isBusinessInfoComplete(),
    tossClientKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TOSS_CLIENT_KEY || null,
    portoneStoreId: getPortoneStoreId(),
    stripePublishableKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || null,
  });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE,
  ADMIN_SESSION_MAX_AGE,
  adminCookieOptions,
  createAdminSessionToken,
  validateAdminCredentials,
} from "@/lib/adminAuth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

/**
 * Dedicated admin portal login.
 * Sets HTTP-only `sca_admin_session` cookie (not the public Auth.js user session).
 */
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  let email = "";
  let password = "";
  try {
    const body = (await req.json()) as { email?: string; password?: string };
    email = String(body.email || "");
    password = String(body.password || "");
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const result = validateAdminCredentials(email, password);
  if (!result.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const token = createAdminSessionToken(result.email);
  const response = NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    user: { email: result.email },
  });
  response.cookies.set(
    ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE,
    token,
    adminCookieOptions(ADMIN_SESSION_MAX_AGE)
  );
  return response;
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAdminSession } from "@/lib/adminAuth";
import {
  bulkCreatePromotionCodes,
  listPromotionAdminData,
  PROMOTION_CREDIT_OPTIONS,
} from "@/lib/promotions";
import type { PromotionCreditOption } from "@/lib/db/types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  return NextResponse.json(listPromotionAdminData());
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session?.user?.email) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }
  const body = (await req.json()) as {
    creditAmount?: PromotionCreditOption;
    quantity?: number;
  };
  if (
    !body.creditAmount ||
    !PROMOTION_CREDIT_OPTIONS.includes(body.creditAmount) ||
    !body.quantity
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_input" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  try {
    const result = await bulkCreatePromotionCodes({
      creditAmount: body.creditAmount,
      quantity: body.quantity,
      createdBy: session.user.email,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "generation_failed" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}

FILE PATH: app/api/admin/refunds/route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/adminAuth";
import {
  processPaymentRefund,
  restoreCreditsForSystemError,
} from "@/lib/payments/refund";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

/**
 * Admin exception / system-error refund path (Article 6).
 * Body:
 *  - { orderId, mode: "system_error"|"admin_exception", reason? }
 *  - { action: "restore_credits", userId, amount, orderId?, note? }
 */
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    await requireAdmin();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    action?: string;
    orderId?: string;
    mode?: "system_error" | "admin_exception";
    reason?: string;
    userId?: string;
    amount?: number;
    note?: string;
  };

  if (body.action === "restore_credits") {
    if (!body.userId || body.amount == null) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "userId and amount required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    const user = await restoreCreditsForSystemError({
      userId: body.userId,
      amount: body.amount,
      orderId: body.orderId,
      note: body.note,
    });
    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "user not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      credits: user.credits,
      userId: user.id,
    });
  }

  if (!body.orderId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "orderId required" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const mode = body.mode === "admin_exception" ? "admin_exception" : "system_error";

  try {
    const result = await processPaymentRefund({
      orderId: body.orderId,
      mode,
      reason: body.reason,
    });
    if (!result.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: result.denialReason, message: result.message },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      orderId: result.order.id,
      refundId: result.refundId,
      clawedCredits: result.clawedCredits,
      status: result.order.status,
      mode,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "refund failed" },
      { status: 502 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { getAdminSession } from "@/lib/adminAuth";
import {
  listSupportTickets,
  updateSupportTicket,
} from "@/lib/db/supportTickets";
import type { SupportTicketStatus } from "@/lib/db/types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const tickets = await listSupportTickets();
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, tickets });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[api/admin/tickets] GET", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "list_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

type PatchBody = {
  id?: string;
  status?: SupportTicketStatus;
  adminNote?: string;
};

export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let body: PatchBody;
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as PatchBody;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_body" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const id = String(body.id || "").trim();
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id_required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const status = body.status;
  if (
    status != null &&
    status !== "open" &&
    status !== "in_progress" &&
    status !== "resolved"
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "status_invalid" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const ticket = await updateSupportTicket(id, {
      ...(status ? { status } : {}),
      ...(body.adminNote !== undefined
        ? { adminNote: String(body.adminNote).slice(0, 4000) }
        : {}),
    });
    if (!ticket) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_found" }, { status: 404 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ticket });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[api/admin/tickets] PATCH", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "update_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE PATH: app/api/auth/email-signup/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import {
  isValidEmailFormat,
  validatePasswordStrength,
} from "@/lib/authValidation";
import { createSupabaseServiceClient, getSupabaseServiceRoleKey } from "@/lib/supabase/service";
import { getSupabaseUrl } from "@/lib/supabase/config";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

type Body = {
  email?: string;
  password?: string;
  name?: string;
};

/**
 * Create an email/password user with email already confirmed (no inbox wait).
 * Used for immediate activation after [회원가입] — required for payment review flows.
 * Client must follow with signInWithPassword to establish browser Supabase cookies.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let body: Body;
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as Body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const email = String(body.email || "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  const password = String(body.password || "");
  const name = String(body.name || "")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

  if (!email) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "email_required", code: "email_required" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!isValidEmailFormat(email)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "email_invalid", code: "email_invalid" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!password) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "password_required", code: "password_required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  if (password.length < 8 || !validatePasswordStrength(password)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "password_weak", code: "password_weak" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  if (!name) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "name_required", code: "name_required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const admin = createSupabaseServiceClient();
  if (!admin) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not configured",
        code: "service_unavailable",
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({
      email,
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: {
        name,
        full_name: name,
      },
    });

    if (!error && data.user) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        userId: data.user.id,
        email: data.user.email,
      });
    }

    const message = error?.message || "createUser failed";
    const lower = message.toLowerCase();
    const already =
      lower.includes("already") ||
      lower.includes("registered") ||
      lower.includes("exists") ||
      error?.code === "email_exists" ||
      error?.status === 422;

    if (already) {
      // Unconfirmed leftover from prior signup — confirm + refresh password/metadata.
      const recovered = await recoverUnconfirmedUser(admin, email, password, name);
      if (recovered === "exists") {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "email_exists", code: "email_exists" },
          { status: 409 }
        );
      }
      if (recovered === "ok") {
        return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, recovered: true, email });
      }
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "email_exists", code: "email_exists" },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    console.error("[auth/email-signup]", message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: message, code: "auth_error" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "email signup failed";
    console.error("[auth/email-signup]", message, err);
    // Never surface mail-provider failures as a hard block if the user was created.
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message, code: "auth_error" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

type AdminClient = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof createSupabaseServiceClient>>;

async function findUserIdByEmail(
  admin: AdminClient,
  email: string
): Promise<{ id: string; confirmed: boolean } | null> {
  try {
    // GoTrue admin list supports email filter via REST.
    const url = getSupabaseUrl()?.replace(/\/$/, "");
    const key = getSupabaseServiceRoleKey();
    if (url && key) {
      const res = await fetch(
        `${url}/auth/v1/admin/users?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
            apikey: key,
          },
          cache: "no-store",
        }
      );
      if (res.ok) {
        const json = (await res.json()) as {
          users?: Array<{
            id: string;
            email?: string;
            email_confirmed_at?: string | null;
          }>;
          id?: string;
          email_confirmed_at?: string | null;
        };
        const users = Array.isArray(json.users)
          ? json.users
          : json.id
            ? [
                {
                  id: json.id,
                  email,
                  email_confirmed_at: json.email_confirmed_at,
                },
              ]
            : [];
        const match = users.find(
          (u) => (u.email || "").toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()
        );
        if (match?.id) {
          return {
            id: match.id,
            confirmed: Boolean(match.email_confirmed_at),
          };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[auth/email-signup] email lookup failed", err);
  }

  // Fallback: scan first pages (small projects / review accounts).
  try {
    for (let page = 1; page <= 5; page++) {
      const { data, error } = await admin.auth.admin.listUsers({
        page,
        perPage: 200,
      });
      if (error) break;
      const match = data.users.find(
        (u) => (u.email || "").toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()
      );
      if (match) {
        return {
          id: match.id,
          confirmed: Boolean(match.email_confirmed_at),
        };
      }
      if (data.users.length < 200) break;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[auth/email-signup] listUsers fallback failed", err);
  }

  return null;
}

async function recoverUnconfirmedUser(
  admin: AdminClient,
  email: string,
  password: string,
  name: string
): Promise<"ok" | "exists" | "fail"> {
  try {
    const found = await findUserIdByEmail(admin, email);
    if (!found) return "exists";
    if (found.confirmed) return "exists";

    const { error } = await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(found.id, {
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: { name, full_name: name },
    });
    if (error) {
      console.warn("[auth/email-signup] confirm existing failed", error.message);
      return "fail";
    }
    return "ok";
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[auth/email-signup] recover failed", err);
    return "fail";
  }
}

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import {
  fetchKakaoOidcUserinfo,
  normalizeKakaoAuthorization,
} from "@/lib/supabase/kakao-userinfo";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Userinfo proxy for Supabase Custom OAuth (`custom:kakao`).
 *
 * Avoids built-in Kakao provider KOE205 (hardcoded `account_email` scope).
 * Flattens `/v2/user/me` → `{ sub, email, name, picture, … }`.
 *
 * Dashboard → Authentication → Providers → Custom (identifier: `kakao`):
 *   Authorization = https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/authorize
 *   Token         = https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/token
 *   Userinfo URL  = https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/api/auth/kakao/userinfo
 *   Scopes        = profile_nickname profile_image
 *                   (no account_email, no openid)
 * Prefer Edge Function if Vercel Deployment Protection is on
 * (see supabase/functions/kakao-userinfo).
 */
export async function OPTIONS() {
  return new NextResponse(null, {
    status: 204,
    headers: {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Authorization, Content-Type",
    },
  });
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const headerAuth =
    request.headers.get("authorization") ?? request.headers.get("Authorization");
  const queryToken = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("access_token");
  const authorization =
    normalizeKakaoAuthorization(headerAuth) ??
    normalizeKakaoAuthorization(queryToken ? `Bearer ${queryToken}` : null);

  if (!authorization) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Missing Authorization header (expected: Bearer <kakao_access_token>)" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const result = await fetchKakaoOidcUserinfo(authorization);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: result.status });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(result.body, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
      },
    });
  } catch (err) {

    console.error("Kakao userinfo proxy error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });

FILE PATH: app/api/auth/logout/route.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import {
  authCookieOptions,
  authCallbackUrlCookieName,
  authCsrfCookieName,
  authSessionCookieName,
} from "@/lib/authCookies";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

/**
 * Clears Auth.js, Supabase, locale, and other host cookies seen on the request.
 * Pair with client-side Supabase signOut() + storage purge.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  const cleared = { ...authCookieOptions(0), maxAge: 0 };
  response.cookies.set(authSessionCookieName(), "", cleared);
  response.cookies.set(authCsrfCookieName(), "", cleared);
  response.cookies.set(authCallbackUrlCookieName(), "", {
    ...cleared,
    httpOnly: false,
  });

  for (const cookie of request.cookies.getAll()) {
    response.cookies.set(cookie.name, "", {
      ...cleared,
      httpOnly: false,
    });
  }
  return response;
}

FILE PATH: app/api/auth/naver/userinfo/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import {
  fetchNaverOidcUserinfo,
  normalizeNaverAuthorization,
} from "@/lib/supabase/naver-userinfo";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Userinfo proxy for Supabase Custom OAuth (`custom:naver`).
 *
 * Supabase Auth (GoTrue) calls this with Authorization: Bearer <naver_access_token>.
 * We call https://openapi.naver.com/v1/nid/me and flatten
 * `{ resultcode, response: { id, email, ... } }` → `{ sub, email, ... }`.
 *
 * Dashboard → Authentication → Providers → Custom (naver) → Manual OAuth2:
 *   Userinfo URL = https://www.studio-canvas-ai.com/api/auth/naver/userinfo
 *   Scopes = profile  (do NOT include openid)
 * Prefer Edge Function URL if Vercel Deployment Protection is enabled
 * (see supabase/functions/naver-userinfo).
 */
export async function OPTIONS() {
  return new NextResponse(null, {
    status: 204,
    headers: {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Authorization, Content-Type",
    },
  });
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Prefer standard header; allow access_token query as a debug fallback.
  const headerAuth =
    request.headers.get("authorization") ?? request.headers.get("Authorization");
  const queryToken = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("access_token");
  const authorization =
    normalizeNaverAuthorization(headerAuth) ??
    normalizeNaverAuthorization(queryToken ? `Bearer ${queryToken}` : null);

  if (!authorization) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Missing Authorization header (expected: Bearer <naver_access_token>)" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const result = await fetchNaverOidcUserinfo(authorization);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: result.status });
    }

    // Explicit JSON body — top-level email/sub for GoTrue Claims unmarshal.
    return NextResponse.json(result.body, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
      },
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("Naver userinfo proxy error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

================================================
FILE PATH: app/api/auth/supabase-bridge/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { createSessionFromSupabaseAccessToken } from "@/lib/createSupabaseSession";

/**
 * Establishes a NextAuth JWT session from a Supabase access token.
 * Avoids client-side `signIn("supabase")` which requires a CSRF double-submit
 * cookie that often goes missing after the OAuth redirect chain.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let accessToken = "";
  const contentType = request.headers.get("content-type") || "";

  try {
    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      const body = (await request.json()) as { accessToken?: string };
      accessToken = String(body.accessToken || "").trim();
    } else {
      const form = await request.formData();
      accessToken = String(form.get("accessToken") || "").trim();
    }
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!accessToken) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing accessToken" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const session = await Promise.race([
      createSessionFromSupabaseAccessToken(accessToken),
      new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
        setTimeout(
          () => reject(new Error("Session creation timed out after 12s")),
          12_000
        );
      }),
    ]);
    const response = NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      user: session.user,
      needsTermsConsent: session.needsTermsConsent,
    });
    response.cookies.set(session.cookieName, session.token, session.cookieOptions);
    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Bridge failed";
    console.error("[auth/supabase-bridge]", message, err);
    const status =
      message.includes("Invalid Supabase") || message.includes("access token")
        ? 401
        : 500;
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
  }
}

FILE PATH: app/api/credits/spend/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { debitCredits } from "@/lib/db/credits";
import { DOWNLOAD_CREDIT_COST } from "@/lib/data";
import { resolveAppUser } from "@/lib/resolveAppUser";
import type { CreditLedgerEntry } from "@/lib/db/types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const ALLOWED_REASONS = new Set<CreditLedgerEntry["reason"]>([
  "download",
  "regenerate",
  "generate",
]);

/**
 * Explicit credit spend for client actions that are not gated by /api/generate
 * (e.g. finished-work downloads from the result workspace).
 */
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const resolved = await resolveAppUser(req);
  if (!resolved.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: resolved.error },
      { status: resolved.status }
    );
  }

  let body: {
    amount?: number;
    reason?: CreditLedgerEntry["reason"];
    meta?: CreditLedgerEntry["meta"];
  } = {};
  try {
    body = (await req.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    body = {};
  }

  const reason = body.reason && ALLOWED_REASONS.has(body.reason) ? body.reason : "download";
  const amountRaw =
    typeof body.amount === "number" && Number.isFinite(body.amount)
      ? body.amount
      : reason === "download"
        ? DOWNLOAD_CREDIT_COST
        : 1;
  const amount = Math.round(Math.max(0, amountRaw) * 10) / 10;
  if (amount <= 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "invalid_amount", message: "Spend amount must be positive." },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const debit = await debitCredits({
    userId: resolved.user.id,
    amount,
    reason,
    meta: {
      source: "credits_spend_api",
      ...body.meta,
    },
  });

  if (!debit.ok) {
    if (debit.reason === "insufficient") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "insufficient_credits",
          message: "Insufficient credits.",
          credits: debit.credits ?? resolved.user.credits,
        },
        { status: 402 }
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    creditsAfter: debit.user.credits,
    ledgerId: debit.entry.id,
    amount,
    reason,
  });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { expirePromotionCodes } from "@/lib/promotions";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

/** Daily cron: expire prepaid promotion balances 180 days after issuance. */
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const secret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (!secret && process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "cron_not_configured" }, { status: 503 });
  }
  const authorization = req.headers.get("authorization");
  const cronHeader = req.headers.get("x-cron-secret");
  if (secret && authorization !== `Bearer ${secret}` && cronHeader !== secret) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  const result = await expirePromotionCodes();
  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    ...result,
    ranAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
}

/** POST — upsert one face/object training profile (photos → R2 URLs). */
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const resolved = await resolveAppUser(req);
  if (!resolved.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: resolved.error },
      { status: resolved.status }
    );
  }

  let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    body = (await req.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_json" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const id = String(body.id ?? "").trim();
  const name = String(body.name ?? "").trim();
  const photoUrls = Array.isArray(body.photoUrls)
    ? body.photoUrls.filter((u): u is string => typeof u === "string" && u.length > 0)
    : [];

  if (!id || !name || photoUrls.length < 1) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "id_name_photos_required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const profile = await upsertUserFaceProfile(resolved.user.id, {
      id,
      name,
      slot: typeof body.slot === "number" ? body.slot : 1,
      photoUrls,
      createdAt: typeof body.createdAt === "number" ? body.createdAt : undefined,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, profile });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[face-profiles/upsert]", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "upsert_failed", message: "Failed to save model profile" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE PATH: app/api/fal/upload/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  ensureFalHttpsImageUrl,
  hasFalCredentials,
  logFalApiError,
} from "@/lib/ai/fal";
import { checkGenerateRateLimit } from "@/lib/rateLimit";
import { resolveAppUser } from "@/lib/resolveAppUser";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const maxDuration = 60;

/** ~3.2MB JSON ceiling — stay under Vercel’s ~4.5MB body limit. */
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 3_200_000;
/** Single data-URI character budget (~2.4MB binary after base64). */
const MAX_DATA_URI_CHARS = 3_200_000;

/**
 * Upload one face/reference image to Fal CDN.
 * Body: { image: string } — https URL (passthrough) or data:image/…;base64,…
 * Returns: { ok: true, url: "https://…" }
 */
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const contentLength = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
    if (contentLength > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "payload_too_large",
          message:
            "Image payload exceeds the upload limit. Compress the photo and try again.",
        },
        { status: 413 }
      );
    }

    if (!hasFalCredentials()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "fal_unconfigured",
          message: "FAL_KEY is not configured on the server.",
        },
        { status: 503 }
      );
    }

    const resolved = await resolveAppUser(req);
    const userId = resolved.ok ? resolved.user.id : null;
    const rl = checkGenerateRateLimit(req, userId);
    if (!rl.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "rate_limited",
          message: "Too many upload requests. Please try again shortly.",
          resetAt: rl.resetAt,
        },
        { status: 429 }
      );
    }

    let raw: { image?: string; imageUrl?: string };
    try {
      raw = (await req.json()) as { image?: string; imageUrl?: string };
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "invalid_json",
          message: "Request body must be JSON with an image field.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const image =
      (typeof raw.image === "string" && raw.image.trim()) ||
      (typeof raw.imageUrl === "string" && raw.imageUrl.trim()) ||
      "";

    if (!image) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "image_required",
          message: "Provide image (data URI or https URL).",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (image.startsWith("blob:")) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "invalid_image_url",
          message: "blob: URLs cannot be uploaded from the server.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (image.startsWith("data:") && image.length > MAX_DATA_URI_CHARS) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "payload_too_large",
          message:
            "Image data URI is too large. Compress to ≤1024px JPEG before upload.",
        },
        { status: 413 }
      );
    }

    // Already on Fal CDN — no re-upload.
    if (
      /^https:\/\//i.test(image) &&
      (image.includes("fal.media") || image.includes("fal.ai"))
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, url: image });
    }

    const url = await ensureFalHttpsImageUrl(image);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, url });
  } catch (error) {
    logFalApiError(
      (error as { response?: { data?: unknown } })?.response
        ? error
        : { response: { data: error instanceof Error ? error.message : error } },
      { stage: "api_fal_upload" }
    );
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: "upload_failed",
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "upload_failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
